description.value: Mucho Burrito is a Canadian fast-casual Mexican chain offering build-your-own burritos, bowls, tacos, and quesadillas made with fresh, house-prepared ingredients. This location is on the second floor of a shopping complex (unit D130) in the Lower Mainland/Fraser Valley region. The menu includes a range of dietary accommodations including vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options.
